title: Product traceability
lead: The barcode identifies a product. Sources determine what can actually be verified about it.
empty_state: No traceability result has been supplied to this view yet.
principle: An absence only means “not verified in the sources consulted”. BOTIA does not turn absence into “not certified”, “not halal”, “not cruelty-free” or “tested on animals”.
disclaimer: BOTIA shows the source, subject, scope and date when they are available.
